title: The Magic City

pages.text: Once upon a time, there was a magic city by the sea.
pages.scene: A sparkling coastal city with tall crystal towers and glowing bridges at sunset.

pages.text: In the center of the city stood a giant ice palace.
pages.scene: A magnificent ice palace with frozen spires in a busy city square.

pages.text: A young girl named Grace lived near the edge of the city.
pages.scene: A kind-looking girl with braids standing outside a cozy cottage near city walls.

pages.text: Grace loved to dance on the stage at the circus.
pages.scene: Grace dancing gracefully on a colorful circus stage under bright lights.

pages.text: One day, a gentle giant came to the city from far away.
pages.scene: A friendly giant walking toward the city gates, villagers looking up in wonder.

pages.text: The giant had a kind face and gentle eyes that sparkled.
pages.scene: Close-up of the giant's friendly face with warm, twinkling eyes.

pages.text: He needed to cross the bridge over the deep gorge.
pages.scene: The giant standing before a rope bridge spanning a misty gorge.

pages.text: But the bridge was made of ice and looked too fragile.
pages.scene: The delicate ice bridge glistening, cracks visible in the frozen surface.

pages.text: The giant was in danger of falling into the gorge below.
pages.scene: The giant carefully stepping on the bridge, looking down nervously.

pages.text: Grace ran to the center of the city to find the mage.
pages.scene: Grace running through crowded city streets toward a tower with magic symbols.

pages.text: The mage was a wise woman who knew ancient magic spells.
pages.scene: An elderly woman in robes surrounded by glowing books and potions.

pages.text: She gave Grace a special gem that glowed with orange energy.
pages.scene: The mage placing a bright orange crystal in Grace's outstretched hands.

pages.text: Grace ran back to the bridge at the edge of the city.
pages.scene: Grace sprinting through the streets, the gem glowing in her pocket.

pages.text: She placed the gem on the ledge by the frozen bridge.
pages.scene: Grace carefully setting the gem on a stone ledge near the ice bridge.

pages.text: The magic changed the ice into strong stone in an instant.
pages.scene: The ice bridge transforming into solid stone, magic sparkles everywhere.

pages.text: The giant could now cross the bridge with no danger at all.
pages.scene: The smiling giant walking confidently across the sturdy stone bridge.

pages.text: He gave Grace a hug and danced a gentle dance of joy.
pages.scene: The giant and Grace dancing together in celebration, villagers clapping.

pages.text: Since that day, Grace became a hero of the magic city.
pages.scene: Grace standing on a stage receiving a medal, crowds cheering.

pages.text: The giant visits the city center every year in the spring.
pages.scene: The giant walking through blooming city gardens, waving to happy citizens.

pages.text: And Grace still dances on the stage at the circus with joy.
pages.scene: Grace performing a beautiful dance on stage, spotlights shining, audience applauding.

parent_tips.before_reading: Read the title 'The Magic City' and look at the cover. Ask: What might happen in this story? This book focuses on Soft C and G.
parent_tips.during_reading: Encourage your child to read independently. When they get stuck, help them use context clues and Soft C and G patterns.
parent_tips.after_reading: Ask deeper questions: Why do you think Grace made that choice? How did the story change from beginning to end? What would you have done?
